claims.assertion: Athena Swaruu claims Giza’s major structures belonged to an older Federation-linked starport city, with extensive underground levels remaining beneath the plateau.
claims.speaker: Athena Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She contrasts this with the conventional account of ancient Egypt.

claims.assertion: Athena says the familiar Egyptian civilization inherited earlier structures and disputes the conventional accounts of pharaohs and mass slavery.
claims.speaker: Athena Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: This is an alternative-history claim, not established archaeology.
